grade_line: Documented: the atlas’s own register of graded claims
title: Of the atlas’s five topic hubs, “Public services where you live” has the largest share of documented claims, 84.5 percent, and “Voice, power and information” the smallest, 67.2.
measure_line: Claims behind the atlas’s 16 everyday answers, grouped by its five topic hubs, as a share of each hub’s claims by evidence grade, 433 claims checked through October 15, 2026, United States.
notes: Grades: Documented, on the public record; Well supported, strong research evidence; Plausible, some evidence; Contested, evidence disputed. A claim’s grade covers that claim alone.
